channel.title: Buildiful 365 — One Free Tool a Day
channel.description: New free, open-source tools from Buildiful®.

item.title: Recipe Builder — Day 015
item.description: Discover recipes based on the ingredients you already have.

item.title: Camera — Day 014
item.description: Turn your device into a customizable digital camera.

item.title: Computer Upcycler — Day 013
item.description: Give your old computer a new life with a step-by-step Ubuntu installation guide.

item.title: Package Manager — Day 012
item.description: Keep track of your package deliveries.

item.title: Time Travel Tracker — Day 011
item.description: Log flights and see how far you've traveled forward or backward in time.

item.title: Pair Where? — Day 010
item.description: Challenge your memory by finding the pairs, then sort the revealed cards into numerical order.

item.title: Stepcells — Day 009
item.description: Solve word puzzles one cell at a time.

item.title: 8-Bit Converter — Day 008
item.description: Turn your images into retro 8-bit pixel art.

item.title: Boxophone — Day 007
item.description: Play various musical instruments in your browser.

item.title: Volume Normalizer — Day 006
item.description: Normalize audio files for consistent playback volume.

item.title: Music Player — Day 005
item.description: Play and organize your own music library in the browser, including offline after setup.

item.title: Font Builder — Day 004
item.description: Draw or upload your own characters and turn them into an installable font.

item.title: GIF Builder — Day 003
item.description: Make animated GIFs from your images or build them frame by frame.

item.title: Card Builder — Day 002
item.description: Design and export custom cards, announcements, and graphics for any occasion.

item.title: Book Builder — Day 001
item.description: Turn your manuscript into publish-ready paperback files, complete with interior pages and a cover.
